DOCUMENTATION-BASED SELECTION

Why it is a Featured Tool

Schema-defined extraction and source-grounded content make it worth evaluating when developers need fields that reviewers can inspect.

Before you choose: Test field attribution and missing values. A commercial API may be unnecessary for a spreadsheet-only workflow.

Limitations to check

Distinguish Parse content blocks from Extract field values. Check complex documents, missing fields, and cross-page table citations.

Build a meaningful sample

Include your hardest pages: low-quality scans, missing fields, dense tables, and evidence split across pages. Validate output correctness separately from citation accuracy.
